description: Shared Renovate policy for the MurineShiftWork fleet. Repos consume it with { "extends": ["github>MurineShiftWork/renovate-config"] }.

packageRules.description: Never bump the Python runtime: repos pin requires-python; Renovate must not propose 3.14+
Ignore everything by default (third-party libs, GitHub Actions, Python): no continuous churn
Manage only the MSW ecosystem packages; bump their floors, batched into one weekly PR
Non-major MSW bumps auto-merge on green CI (each cuts a release pinning the latest floors)
Major MSW bumps land as a manual PR (review before release)
